bundle.shortDescription: Manage VRChat projects and VPM packages
bundle.longDescription: An open-source manager for VRChat Unity projects and VPM packages, built on vrc-get. It creates, backs up, migrates and duplicates projects and installs, upgrades and removes packages. It is not made or endorsed by VRChat.
